insight: Started as a game-NPC 'character engine' that hit a $500M+ valuation in 2023 before pivoting to a voice-AI runtime for agents.
name: Inworld AI
tagline: A full-stack voice runtime for building human-sounding AI agents.
description: A developer platform for real-time voice AI — an integrated STT + LLM + TTS pipeline exposed through REST and WebSocket APIs (OpenAI Realtime-compatible) for companions, character chat, support, and phone agents. Beyond the voice stack it offers a model Router, inference, and compute, with cloud and enterprise on-prem deployment.

modelSupport.notes: Inworld's own TTS/STT models; a Router can dispatch to third-party LLMs.

edge: Bundles STT, LLM routing, and TTS into one voice pipeline, priced aggressively for consumer-scale voice agents.
cons: Developer API, not an end-user app
Pivoted from its original character-engine focus
Voice quality varies by model tier

references.title: Inworld Cuts Prices to Take Down the Biggest Wall in Consumer AI: Cost
